a reset of its stream ends it
a connection lost while it is read ends it

a track found malformed is asked again after the pause
a refusal without a time
a refusal that names 3 s

a track that gives up on a failure: not answered
an end has it asked again whatever it does on a failure
a message that breaks the protocol on its stream closes the session
an answer that breaks the protocol closes the session
a track asked again 2 times in a row is given up the third time
